subject.title: feat(cron): script payloads behind the trigger gate

question: Should this new persisted cron payload kind and its 900-second/200-tool unattended execution envelope be accepted under the existing `cron.triggers.enabled` gate?
rationale: The broader feature direction is already described as decided, but the final compatibility and operating-envelope acceptance is a maintainer judgment that tests alone cannot make.

options.title: Approve after compatibility proof
options.body: Require a focused persisted-row upgrade/downgrade check plus a redacted real gated cron-run transcript, then continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Reduce or defer the payload-grade budget expansion while retaining the shared runtime and script-payload contract.

options.title: Pause this stage
options.body: Keep the broader cron proposal open and defer script payloads until the persisted-payload compatibility policy is explicitly settled.

recommendation.title: Approve after compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Require a focused persisted-row upgrade/downgrade check plus a redacted real gated cron-run transcript, then continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked canonical proposal and this branch both place this feature direction and its staged boundary with steipete.
